subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A city park stopped cutting one large grass area every week.”?
options: One day, Mrs. Lin cut an ugly apple into pieces and let customers try it.
Instead of removing the line, the city turned it into a walking and biking path.
Instead, it let wildflowers grow and cut only walking paths.
Students visiting the park saw grass, trees, and walking paths.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「One day, Mrs. Lin cut an ugly apple into pieces and let customers try it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Instead of removing the line, the city turned it into a walking and biking path.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Instead, it let wildflowers grow and cut only walking paths.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Students visiting the park saw grass, trees, and walking paths.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Instead, it let wildflowers grow and cut only walking paths.」，答案為「Instead, it let wildflowers grow and cut only walking paths.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Instead, it let wildflowers grow and cut only walking paths.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
